# wso2is_dcr_configuration (Resource)

Manages OAuth2 dynamic client registration (`/api/identity/oauth2/dcr/v1.1/register`). The resource only changes the settings that you set. Other settings keep their current values. When you destroy this resource, the settings keep their current values, and Terraform stops managing them. Each tenant (or organization) has one set of these settings. To import them, use the ID `dcr_configuration`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_dcr_configuration" "this" {
  authentication_required = true
  mandate_ssa             = true
  ssa_jwks                = "https://directory.example.com/jwks"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `authentication_required` (Boolean) Require authentication to register clients.
- `enable_fapi_enforcement` (Boolean) Enforce FAPI rules on registered clients.
- `mandate_ssa` (Boolean) Require a software statement assertion.
- `ssa_jwks` (String) JWKS URL used to validate software statement assertions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `dcr_configuration`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_dcr_configuration.this dcr_configuration
```
